title: M1.17 final clean-build source is not fully retained
source_evidence: M1_17_SOURCE_PROVENANCE_AND_PACKAGE_NOTE.md; exact accepted standalone source for Programs 124C–128 not retained; Program 127 absent from current package.
campaign_risk: A fresh campaign cannot be executed through G2 from one verified final clean-build M1.17 source chain.
required_remediation: Create, statically validate, and formally approve a consolidated M1.17 clean-build source replacement before harness execution. Preserve the existing provenance note and do not falsely label reconstructed source as the historical executed bytes.

title: Fixed governed run identity is embedded across the source chain
source_evidence: 208 normal source files contain the fixed run code; 583 executable-line findings.
campaign_risk: A new 25,000-application run cannot safely coexist with or automatically resolve independently from the accepted certification cohort.
required_remediation: Introduce a governed campaign context and replace fixed run-code/version predicates with an approved current-campaign resolver or generated campaign-specific source.
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Campaign cardinalities are embedded as fixed acceptance expectations
source_evidence: 102 files reference 750; 68 files reference 1,500; fixed history/monitoring counts also appear in the source.

required_remediation: Move campaign inputs into governed configuration and derive expected counts from population size, scenario count, history days, and persisted predecessor outcomes.
rebase_scope_update: M1.2 through M2.12 validations, finalizers and reports
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Fixed synthetic dates appear in executable source

title: Preflight and generation logic assume one pristine stage sequence
source_evidence: Module guides repeatedly require accepted predecessor status and empty current-stage targets; generation scripts are marked do-not-rerun after commit.
campaign_risk: Rerunning in the accepted database could collide with latest/archive/registry keys or overwrite campaign state.
required_remediation: Use a dedicated campaign database and a unique governed campaign/run identity; harness resume must continue only from the first incomplete checkpoint.
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Detailed evidence is designed around many interactive result sets
source_evidence: 27 detail-report programs remain in the normal chain; many module guides require 17–24 result-set exports and DBeaver result tabs.
campaign_risk: Manual export does not scale and creates filename, omission, and evidence-index risk.
required_remediation: Create persisted campaign evidence views and a machine-readable export plan; always export summaries/exceptions, retain detailed reports on demand.
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Some validation programs intentionally expose session-preserved temporary results
source_evidence: 100 normal programs contain ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS; 132 use temporary tables.
affected_scope: Primarily validation, negative-control and report programs
campaign_risk: Running each statement in a different connection can lose filterable/output state.
required_remediation: Execute each SQL file in one psql session, capture final outputs before connection close, and replace DBeaver-only review dependencies with persisted or export-specific queries.
rebase_scope_update: Primarily validation, negative-control and report programs
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Module execution catalogs use heterogeneous schemas and some stages lack a current accepted clean-build catalog
source_evidence: Catalog headers vary across execution_order, order, sequence, file/path/program, checkpoint/required_result, rerun fields; G0 and G1 rely on guides.
campaign_risk: A runner cannot consume catalogs uniformly without custom module-specific parsing.
required_remediation: Compile one normalized campaign execution plan with fixed fields and exact source hashes after M2.12 acceptance.

title: Checkpoint expectations are textual rather than uniformly executable
source_evidence: Execution catalogs contain human-readable required results, but not a standard checkpoint SQL path, expected schema, or machine assertion rule.
campaign_risk: A zero SQL exit code could be mistaken for a governed PASS.
required_remediation: Create one post-program checkpoint query per execution step and require both SQL success and checkpoint PASS before advancing.
m2_12_rebase_evidence: Re-scanned 230-position accepted plan; predecessor gap remains unless separately closed.

title: Scale-sensitive generation and validation stages require a volume/performance shakedown
source_evidence: M1.4–M1.6 create daily histories and matched scenarios; M1.9/M1.13 create long-form and path rows; M2.5 creates account-day monitoring rows.

campaign_risk: A 25,000-application run creates tens of millions of daily rows before downstream components, archives and controls.
required_remediation: Run a disposable 2,500-application shakedown after source portability is complete; collect duration, row volume, index, temp-disk and backup metrics.
